task.description:
Build REQ-070 by the checked design docs/design/REQ-070-demo-tenants-v3.md (sub-steps 70a-70d of section 11; the design passed its gate in step 04). Read the design fully first (sections 3-7, 14.1, the path map, the tables of content, the table of edits 6.1, the id renames 6.2, the colours 6.3, the answer sets 7.1), decisions/0086, 0085, the block REQ-070 in docs/requirements.yaml, the sample docs/design/samples/picker-v3-approved-2026-10-26/data.js (source of the ru, kk, en texts, STOCK and AGENCY).
Create exactly: tools/src/picker/demo-tenants-v3/stock.json, tools/src/picker/demo-tenants-v3/agency.json, tools/src/picker/demo-answers-v3/stock.json, tools/src/picker/demo-answers-v3/agency.json, and one paragraph in tools/README.md (14.1; in the section on the stand of made-up tenants; the words may be refined, the facts may not; no mention of other projects). Change nothing else (no src/picker/*.js, no public/, no demo-tenants/, no demo-answers/, no tests: the test file is written by TEST-DESIGNER later). You may generate the files with a throw-away script kept OUTSIDE the project (session scratchpad folder named in the launching message); the committed files are the output run through `npx prettier --write` (JSON.stringify output fails the format check).
Rules: texts of the sample are taken as they are (ru, kk, en), except the rows of the table of edits (E1 the missing tag of "Пока нигде"; E2, E3 the two roles of the second tenant, reason SEP; the kk text of the edits is yours, simple and polite, to be read by an independent reader later), the id renames none -> nowhere (first tenant) / nothing (second tenant), and the two replacement colours chosen by the method of 6.3 (the values of the design). The content the sample lacks (solutions, rules, hypotheses, result settings, leads texts) is exactly the tables of 5.2 and 5.3; you write only the TEXTS of those in three languages: plain, polite, invented (no real company, phone, address, price taken from anywhere; no http addresses, no email-like strings, no paths); the numbers inside one text are the same in ru, kk and en; no Cyrillic in en; the intro's number of questions equals 5 in all three languages; no text shared by the two files (criterion 4), ids not shared either. leads.whatsapp 77010000000 (first tenant) and 77020000000 (second); contact_fields [phone, telegram] and [phone]. Run, one at a time: `cd tools && npm run picker -- check src/picker/demo-tenants-v3/stock.json` and the same for agency.json (code 0, one line «Файл арендатора <id> в порядке: вопросов 5, решений 4, правил 15.»), the real engine on the answer sets for ru, kk and en and compare with table 7.1 of the design (labels, solution ids, scores), the stand `serve --tenants src/picker/demo-tenants-v3 --port 0` once (two links, GET of the questionnaire for six cases gives 200 with look, desk, object), `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run traces` (code 0). Then `cd tools && npm run check` once: it must stay green (2044 tests; the new files are data and README only). Report the translations you wrote that you are least sure of. Write set: the five files above and your handoff. No commits, no git checkout/reset/stash/clean. In your handoff text never list project names or machine paths (say "the traces list"). 16 GB RAM computer: single commands, one server at a time, stop what you start.

result.summary: REQ-070 data built by docs/design/REQ-070-demo-tenants-v3.md, sub-steps 70a-70d. Two tenant files of the format /3 (stock, agency), two answer files (leader, close, none, half) and one README paragraph. The files were generated by a throw-away script kept in <scratch>/d070b (not in the project) from the approved sample and the tables of sections 5 and 6, then run through prettier --write. Edits of the sample texts: E1 (tag of «Пока нигде» absent, stock), E2 and E3 (two roles of agency, reason SEP; the kk and en texts are mine), id renames none -> nowhere (stock) and none -> nothing (agency), colours stock light.accent #d76e1e (3.134) and agency dark.accent2 #6d54da (3.096) by the method of 6.3 (recomputed, equal to the design). Texts of solutions, rules, hypotheses, no_match_text and lead texts are my own, in ru, kk, en. Nothing else changed.
